propositions: A new peer confirmation record store must persist the fact that a managed link was confirmed by the peer, keyed on (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) and storing link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, and source.

The outbound ADD success path through _update_one_dispatch_links must invoke an optional link_confirm callback after set_relationship returns, capturing the returned link_id and never failing the applied link count if the callback raises.

Confirmation records must not be created when the target entity is unbound (get_local_id returns None), and any exception from the confirmation write callback must be logged and swallowed without perturbing link counters.
The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames in reconcile_helpers to ensure confirmation-only changes survive the idempotency guard and are committed.
Loading a corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json must degrade gracefully to an empty store without raising an error.
Snapshot compaction must preserve confirmed peer links through save/load cycles.
